observations: Three photos show a used automatic transmission assembly in a workshop or scrapyard setting.
The unit has a silver-colored metal casing with visible wear, dirt, and some rust.
A black plastic cover is attached to the front, likely for the torque converter or fluid reservoir.
There is a white label on the front cover with a barcode and some text, but the text is too small to read clearly.
A black hose with '1/2"' and 'SPE' markings is connected to the top of the unit.
The background shows other engine parts, tools, and a person working in the distance.
The watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI GEARUP INC.' is overlaid on all photos.

claims.evidence: No visible branding or model identifiers in the photos. The seller's text is not proof.
No engine or cylinder count visible in the photos. The claim cannot be verified from the images alone.

risks.risk: The transmission may be damaged internally or have worn components not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the transmission being tested or a close-up of the internal gears and bearings.

risks.risk: The transmission may not be from a Ford Fusion as claimed.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the transmission's identification plate or VIN tag, or a photo of the engine bay or vehicle it came from.

risks.risk: The transmission may have been salvaged from a wrecked or accident-damaged vehicle.
risks.proof: A photo of the vehicle's VIN plate or a clear shot of the transmission's serial number and any damage indicators.

proof_requests: Close-up of the engine or gearbox code: the plate, sticker or number stamped on the block or case.
Clear photo of the transmission's identification plate or VIN tag.
Video of the transmission being tested or a close-up of internal components.
Photo of the vehicle it came from, if available.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
